title: ‘Love Story’ Showrunner Defends Depiction of JFK Jr. & Carolyn’s Relationship Before Their Final Scene
summary: “We felt like, ‘Well, then this is a privilege for the writers to take some creative license and to choose hope — to choose hope for our rendering of the story, to choose hope for our audience, and to choose hope for John and Carolyn,’” Connor Hines said at a FYC event in New York City Wednesday night.
